wrap_module_with_fsdp: wrap a PyTorch nn.Module with FullyShardedDataParallel to shard parameters across data parallel workers
fsdp_mixed_precision_forward: run a forward pass with FSDP wrapped module using mixed precision FP16 computation and FP32 master weights
fsdp_gather_full_optim_state: gather the full consolidated optimizer state dict from all FSDP ranks using gather_full_optim_state_dict
fsdp_consolidate_shard_weights: consolidate sharded checkpoint weights from multiple ranks into a single unsharded state dict using consolidate_shard_weights
fsdp_auto_wrap_batchnorm: auto wrap all BatchNorm layers in a module with a special single-rank FSDP instance using auto_wrap_bn
